comment.body: Thanks for the screenshot-to-PNG sequence with AI disabled. Paste as .png file is a builtin image-to-file conversion, so creating a PNG does not itself imply AI use. What exact status/message or unexpected image change shows AI being invoked, and is this the builtin action rather than a similarly named custom action? That determines whether there is a dispatch defect; please do not share API keys or provider credentials.
